name: Rooftop selector
distinction: A compact station rail keeps browsing beside a large selected-station stage.
consideration: Balanced browsing and listening; artwork should not crowd the station rail.

name: Record shop
distinction: Six illustrated sleeves make station discovery feel like browsing a record store.
consideration: Easy discovery; a large collection will need efficient scrolling and filtering.

name: Radio zine
distinction: An editorial spread pairs one featured station with a fast, scannable index.
consideration: Strong hierarchy; the featured station should not hide the rest of the library.

name: Transit lines
distinction: A graphic station map explores genre connections, with a clear list alternative.
consideration: Most experimental: spatial browsing needs a fully usable list alternative.

name: Listening desk
distinction: A steady three-pane workspace puts stations, current artwork and seeds side by side.
consideration: Useful while listening; the third pane should collapse cleanly on smaller screens.

name: Poster wall
distinction: Tall station posters create a bold horizontal browse experience.
consideration: Artwork leads; keyboard and touch navigation through the ribbon will matter.

name: Cassette shelf
distinction: Compact station spines open into a cassette-inlay style listening page.
consideration: Compact and distinctive; typography must remain clear across many station names.

name: Split horizon
distinction: An ink-and-art split gives the station identity the strongest visual presence.
consideration: Strongest brand expression; station discovery gets less space than in the list-led options.

name: Street index
distinction: A typography-led station list favors fast scanning and low visual clutter.
consideration: Fastest to scan; station art plays a smaller role.

name: Gallery tunnel
distinction: A vertical sequence of large artwork panels makes browsing feel cinematic.
consideration: Immersive artwork; sticky navigation must keep returning to stations easy.
